mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id, backup_path, file_size, file_md5, file_sha256, status, last_error_code, backup_completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM file_backup_record WHERE file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_backup_record (file_id, file_size, file_md5, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{fileSize}, #{fileMd5}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_size = VALUES(file_size), file_md5 = VALUES(file_md5), status = CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN status ELSE 0 END, last_error_code = CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN last_error_code ELSE NULL END
mapper.update: UPDATE file_backup_record SET backup_path = #{backupPath}, file_size = #{fileSize}, file_md5 = #{fileMd5}, file_sha256 = #{fileSha256}, status = 1, last_error_code = NULL, backup_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
